prompt:
ICON DESIGN LANGUAGE: minimalist MONOLITHIC white glyphs inspired by the rounded organic MAX speech-mark, not generic detailed app clip-art. A single bold connected soft silhouette per icon, with at most one or two LARGE negative-space cutouts. Uniform massive visual weight, bulbous rounded joins, softly asymmetric flowing curvature, no sharp corners. FLAT WHITE, no icon gradients, bevel, shadows or inner outlines. The existing purple glass tile supplies the material. No tiny text-lines, window grids, separate charts with arrows, superimposed tiny pictures, stickers peeling, robot faces with many parts, nested icons, smiley eyes, microphone stands, finger details or photo landscapes. Keep activity recognizable using only its essential silhouette. Do NOT replace everything with the MAX logo: these are distinct semantic pictograms, not brand logo variants. Official MAX logo remains unchanged anywhere it already occurs.
Families: Канал = single soft rounded megaphone with a fused handle, no sound rays or second sheet; Общение/комментарии = one plump bubble with a single broad negative-space opening, no dots; Статистика = one joined rising three-lobe histogram silhouette, no baseline/arrow; Цифровой ID/Бизнес-аккаунт = one filled soft card containing ONE broad person cutout, no text-lines; Отель = a single rounded hotel doorway/keyhole mass with one large door cutout, no many windows or extra key; Льгота = one rounded notched ticket with a single large check cutout; Возраст = one plump solid shield with one check cutout; Видеозвонок = one fused rounded video-camera shape, lens wedge joined; Голосовое/видеокружок = one thick soft voice capsule with one broad slit, no microphone stand or surrounding chat bubble; Групповой чат = one connected soft two-person silhouette with two round head lobes fused to a broad unified body, no separate conversation bubble; Стикер/реакция = one organic solid heart, no face or fold; История = one thick smooth near-closed circular story loop with one generous opening, no broken dashes or mountain/sun; Сфера бизнеса = one plump bag/briefcase silhouette with one handle opening, no extra storefront; Чат-бот = one friendly rounded bot-head silhouette with a SINGLE visor-shaped negative cutout, no antenna, smile, extra chat balloon; Мини-приложение/витрина = one unified rounded shop-bag body with a simple scalloped top and broad handle opening.
Create a polished ICON FAMILY SPECIMEN, landscape canvas, sixteen distinct symbols in a clean 4x4 grid on a completely flat deep violet #0D001A background. No glass tiles, no glow, no decorative texture, no numbers. White glyphs with one small white Russian label below each. Exact labels in grid reading order: "Канал", "Общение", "Статистика", "Цифровой ID"; "Отель", "Льгота", "Возраст", "Видеозвонок"; "Голосовое", "Групповой чат", "Реакция", "История"; "Сфера бизнеса", "Бизнес-аккаунт", "Чат-бот", "Витрина". Minimal consistent glyph family. Each glyph should look cut from ONE soft solid piece with very generous curves, not conventional line icons. No title or other text.
refinement: Edit ONLY THREE glyphs in this icon family sheet. Preserve every other glyph, every exact Russian label, background, grid position and overall size unchanged. 1. "Статистика": join the three rounded rising columns with a generously rounded solid baseline so it is ONE connected white rising stepped silhouette, not three separated pills; no arrow. 2. "Витрина": join the scalloped canopy to the body so it becomes ONE solid shop-bag silhouette; use a small inset negative notch to suggest the canopy but no gap separating the shape. 3. "Голосовое": replace the horizontal minus-like capsule with a recognizable MINIMAL THICK MICROPHONE: large vertical rounded capsule and a short fused base, all soft rounded proportions, at most one broad U-shaped negative cutout, no surrounding bubble. It must read as voice, not minus or battery. All glyphs matte flat white with no shading.
